Class RitualEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.EventCard.EventCard
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.EventCard.RitualEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItaEngRectangable, Rectangable, Serializable, Comparable<EventCard>
public class RitualEvent extends EventCard
Represents the Ritual Event card in the game.

The player with the most icons in their tribe gains the indicated Prestige Points. The player with the fewest icons in their tribe loses the indicated Prestige Points. In the event of a tie, all tied players gain or lose the indicated Prestige Points. Note: In the rare event of a tie among all players, everyone first gains PP and then loses PP. This is important if any Building cards are in play.

  • Method Details

    • resolveEvent

      public void resolveEvent(List<Player> players)
      Resolves the logic and applies the effects of the Shamanic Ritual event to all players.

      This execution follows a specific sequence:

      1. Identifies the losers and assigns them a point penalty (minusPoints).
      2. Identifies the winners and sets their pending reward (a negative plusPoints value).
      3. Checks if there is a solitary winner and sets the unique winner flag accordingly (crucial for cards like DoubleShamanPointsCard).
      4. Invokes BuildingEvent.RITUAL_EVENT to allow defensive or rewarding buildings to activate.
      5. Finalizes the changes by calling Player.confirmToPay() on all players.
      Specified by:
      resolveEvent in class EventCard
      Parameters:
      players - the list of Players participating in the event

    • getRectangleAttributedString

      public RectangleAttributedString getRectangleAttributedString()
      Generates a visually formatted ASCII-art representation of the card for the terminal UI.

      The generated drawing has a fixed height of 4 and a width of 5. It uses a magenta border to visually distinguish Event cards, and includes the specific shamanic ritual symbol (│§│).
